retake.retakeFee: Testing fee may apply per attempt

gdl.fullLicenseMinAge: 17 after holding the intermediate license at least 180 days and completing required driver education
gdl.permitHoldingPeriod: 6 months (no driving midnight-6 a.m. while holding the permit)
gdl.nightCurfew: Intermediate: no driving midnight-6 a.m. unless for work, school, or medical emergency
gdl.passengerLimits: Intermediate: no more than 1 passenger under 20 unless supervised by a driving instructor or accompanying a licensed adult 21+

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity (e.g. certified birth certificate or U.S. passport)
process.realIdNotes: Kentucky's REAL ID (voluntary travel ID) requires proof of identity, SSN, and two proofs of Kentucky residency. A standard credential remains available.
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye (with or without corrective lenses) for an unrestricted license

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 12 or more points in 2 years (drivers 18+); 7 or more points for drivers under 18
facts.moveOverRule: Move over one lane, or slow down if you cannot safely change lanes, for stopped emergency, public-safety, and utility vehicles displaying warning lights (KRS 189.930)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: Reduced posted limit when in effect (commonly 25 mph where posted)

references.label: Testing and Permit Fees
references.citation: Kentucky Division of Driver Licensing fees
